learning.title: Point every tool at the owner's real paths when HOME is the per-session state directory
learning.trigger: Inside an OpenRig seat, once, while an unrelated CLI hangs or reports "not logged into any GitHub hosts". Two different symptoms, one cause: HOME is /home/marktripoli/.openrig/state/omp/<seat>, not /home/marktripoli. Every tool that keeps credentials, browser binaries or trusted-config state under $HOME resolves to the seat's empty directory instead of the owner's.
learning.rule: Set the owner paths explicitly, once per shell, before running anything that needs them. Credentials and trusted config live under /home/marktripoli: use GH_CONFIG_DIR=/home/marktripoli/.config/gh, run the repo's bin/say as HOME=/home/marktripoli bin/say ..., and export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/home/marktripoli/.cache/ms-playwright before any Playwright or agent-browser run. Call installed binaries directly rather than the mise shims, which is the shim half of the same problem and is written up in mise-wrapper-hangs-cli.xml: node is /home/marktripoli/.local/share/mise/installs/node/22.22.0/bin/node, pnpm is /home/marktripoli/.local/share/mise/installs/pnpm/10.33.0/pnpm, gh is /home/marktripoli/.local/share/mise/installs/gh/2.100.0/gh_2.100.0_linux_amd64/bin/gh, and rig is the same node binary running /home/marktripoli/.local/share/mise/installs/node/22.22.0/lib/node_modules/@openrig/cli/dist/bin-wrapper.js. MISE_OFFLINE=1 suppresses the version-fetch noise the shim path adds. A third symptom is the harness issue cache: read issue://MarkTripoli/bakery fails with "mise ERROR Config files in /home/marktripoli/.config/mise/config.toml are not trusted" because the trust record is looked up under the rewritten HOME, so use gh directly for issue and PR reads instead of relying on the cache.

verification.requirement: Show the difference in wall clock and exit status, not in description. Measured on one seat, same shell: rig whoami --json through /home/marktripoli/.local/bin/rig did not finish inside two minutes and printed only mise WARN lines about remote version fetches, while node .../dist/bin-wrapper.js whoami --json returned clean JSON in 0.30s real. gh auth status from the same direct binary reported "You are not logged into any GitHub hosts" in 0.06s, and the same command with GH_CONFIG_DIR=/home/marktripoli/.config/gh reported the logged-in account and token scopes in 0.23s, with gh api rate_limit answering in 0.34s. Record the working environment line next to the command in any handover, so the next occupant does not rediscover it.
